title: Post-Disaster Assessment and Coastal Landscape Survey Using Drone Imagery
author: Cohen, de Souza, et al.
materials: ruler (1–5 m) for ground elevation verification
black rubber mats (1 m2) with a yellow cross for GCPs
electronic self leveling horizontal rotary laser

steps.title: Perform Pre-Disturbance Spatial-Temporal Analysis
steps.instruction: Obtain permanent and regional spatial-temporal analysis using satellite images, aerial images, and lidar data from the period prior to the disturbance event.

steps.title: Construct Local Digital Elevation Models (DEMs)
steps.instruction: Construct local DEMs after the disturbance event using drone aerophotogrammetry and ground control points (GCPs).

substeps.instruction: Utilize a Phantom 4 RTK drone for aerophotogrammetry.

steps.title: Integrate Data in GIS
steps.instruction: Integrate regional and local planialtimetric and environmental data into a Geographic Information System (GIS) using Global Mapper 22.1.2 Software.

substeps.instruction: Use the GIS to assess impact.
Pin-point drone landing and take-off points.
Analyze results and evaluate economic loss.

steps.title: Validate Planialtimetric Data
steps.instruction: Validate the planialtimetric data and classifications using topographic and environmental data obtained during fieldwork.

substeps.instruction: Compare 3D model values (Z3D) against ground values (Zgrd).
Verify accuracy using a Catalyst GNSS receiver (± 1 cm) and a SLHRL (± 2 cm).
Ensure vertical margin of error for 3D models is within ± 5 cm.
